title: Terrain: seeded low-poly island heightmap
description: Deterministic island heightmap: seedable PRNG, coarse grid (PS1-era triangle counts), beach falloff so edges drop below sea level. Expose height_at(x,z) and normal_at(x,z) sampling for gameplay and camera.

title: Low-poly hover car model
description: Faceted low-poly hover car: wedge hull, canopy, fin, hover pods/skirts, hard textures with flat colour panels. Built in code or from an asset file, using vertex colours plus one or two textures.

title: Water wake and delivery effects
description: Water spray particles behind the car, a fading trail on the ocean, and delivery pop effects (sparkles / floating text). Alpha-blended, pooled, fixed-function blending only.

title: island — hover-car package delivery game (PS1-style fixed-function)
description:
Recreate a PS1-style low-poly game: deliver packages to island inhabitants with a floating car that skates above water. OpenGL 1.2/1.5 fixed-function pipeline (GLAD gl=2.1 compat + GLFW legacy context, meson).

Decided: chase camera, car-like handling with drift, sandbox first (no timer in v1).
Target feel: low-poly faceted geometry, hard-edged low-res textures, NEAREST filtering, heavy distance fog, vertex jitter.

NOTE: reference screenshots could not be read by the agent (no image input), so art direction is provisional. Task A2 exists to capture a written spec from them before content work starts.

title: Hard-texture authoring at PS1 resolutions
description: Low-res hard-edged PNGs authored in-repo (grass, sand, rock, wood, roof, road): 64x64/128x128, NEAREST filtering, no mipmaps, hand-painted or procedurally generated with a locked palette. Covers terrain, buildings, car and props.

title: Car hover bob, pitch and bank
description: Hover bob (sine on base position), pitch under accel/brake, roll into turns, slight tilt with terrain normal. Reads as a craft skating rather than a rigid box.

title: Hover car physics: thrust, steering, drift
description: Car-like hover physics: position, heading, velocity, throttle/brake, speed-dependent steering, lateral grip that can be exceeded to produce drift, yaw rate from steering * speed, water drag vs land drag. Runs on the fixed timestep.

title: Asset loading for textures and meshes
description: Simple PNG loader (or reuse the cgltf wrap for meshes) so textures and props are loaded from files instead of hardcoded arrays. NEAREST defaults, no mipmaps, GL_RGBA in GL 1.x.

title: PS1 presentation pass: jitter, affine, low-res
description: Sell the era: sub-triangle vertex snapping jitter, affine texture mapping (GL_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY off, no perspective correction, non-normalized texture coords), heavy linear fog matched to sky colour, low internal resolution with NEAREST upscale.

title: Buildings: house prefab with doorway anchor
description: Low-poly island house prefab (walls, roof, door, windows) with a doorway anchor point used as the delivery target and a resident NPC slot. Placeable on terrain, aligned to slope.

title: Delivery loop state machine
description: Sandbox loop with no timer: idle free-roam, pickup package, deliver to the marked resident, award a small score/floating text, then pick a new random recipient. Driving back to the depot is always allowed.

title: Chase camera with spring follow and heading lag
description: Chase camera replacing the free-fly cam: position = car pos + offset rotated by (heading + lag), critically-damped spring follow, look-at point slightly ahead of the car, speed-based FOV widening and pull-back. Feed from the frame loop.

title: Input manager with actions and edge detection
description: New input.c/h: named actions (throttle, steer, brake, boost, pickup, deliver, look), per-frame edge detection (pressed/released) plus held state, mouse delta accumulation. Move handle_input() out of main.c onto this.

title: Ocean plane with scrolling water texture
description: Large ocean plane at sea level: scrolling hard-edged water texture with NEAREST sampling, two-layer offset for motion, colour grading toward the horizon and matching fog colour so the plane edge is invisible. Buoyant hover behaviour here is what makes the car read as floating.

title: Dev loop: git init, gitignore, run script
description: git init the repo, add .gitignore covering build/ build_macos/ subprojects/packagecache/, add a ./run.sh that sets up+compiles and execs the binary, document the meson commands in README. Commit the existing fixed-function scaffold as the baseline.

title: Render pass system with fixed-function state management
description: Render passes built on a small state manager: sky/ocean/terrain/props/vehicle/particles/HUD, each with explicit lighting + fog + texture + blend state set on entry. Removes ad-hoc glEnable/glDisable scattered through draw code.

title: Collision: terrain height and prop colliders
description: World collision: sample terrain height for ground/air state, circle-vs-circle against prop and building colliders with a bounce/scrub response, keep the car on the ocean plane when over water.

title: Frame loop: fixed-timestep accumulator
description: Replace ad-hoc main.c frame handling with an accumulator loop (e.g. 60Hz logic tick, render as fast as vsync allows), clamped dt, and a frame counter used by physics/animation.

title: Prop scatter system (rocks, palms, clutter)
description: Deterministic scatter of rocks, palms, crates, lamps, fences across island surfaces using a seeded PRNG and terrain slope/height rules. Each prop is low-poly with hard textures; returns a list of colliders for the vehicle.

title: HUD: package status, compass, speed
description: Orthographic overlay pass: package indicator, carried-parcel state, delivered count, speed readout, and a compass/minimap pointing at the active beacon. Rendered after the world with lighting off and depth writes disabled.

title: Shoreline and beach transition
description: Beach ring where terrain crosses sea level: sand blend, wet-sand darkening near the waterline, gentle foam line drawn as geometry or texture band. Visual anchor that reads the island edge.

title: Delivery target beacon
description: Prominent PS1-style beacon at the active recipient's doorway: translucent column or floating holo marker visible above terrain, scaled/alpha-faded with distance so it reads from across the island.

title: Package pickup entity and carry state
description: Spawn a package at a delivery depot on the island; carrying it attaches a parcel mesh to the car and switches HUD state. Picking up again is possible after delivery.

title: Camera collision and above-terrain clamping
description: Raise the chase camera when terrain intrudes between camera and car; clamp camera above terrain/water height so it never clips through the island or dips under the ocean plane.

title: NPC inhabitants with idle and delivery reaction
description: Low-poly island inhabitants near buildings: blocky humanoid, idle sway, turns to face the player, reaction on delivery. Palette-locked flat colours, no skeletal animation needed.

title: Write art-direction spec from reference screenshots
description: The agent cannot read the reference screenshots. Someone must transcribe them into a written art spec: palette (sky/ocean/grass/sand hex values), camera framing and FOV, texture resolution and filtering, fog color/density, silhouette language of car/islands/buildings/NPCs, HUD layout. This spec is the contract for all content tasks (terrain, ocean, car, buildings, textures).

title: Terrain mesh and texturing
description: Terrain mesh textured per surface type (grass/sand/rock) with hard texture-env blends and visible triangle edges, matching the spec palette. Use client-state vertex arrays (glVertexPointer/glTexCoordPointer/glColorPointer) + glDrawArrays, not VBOs.
